recipes.name: Heavenly 'Apple of My Thigh' Dessert
ingredients_raw: 1 (8 ounce) package cream cheese, at room temperature
3 (1.4 ounce) bars chocolate covered English toffee, chopped

steps.text: Mix together the cream cheese, sugar and 1/4 cup of the caramel sauce in a medium bowl. Spread onto a serving tray or a plate. Drizzle the remaining caramel sauce over the top and sprinkle with pieces of chocolate covered toffee. Refrigerate for 30 minutes, then serve with apple slices.

raw_recipe.headline: Heavenly 'Apple of My Thigh' Dessert
raw_recipe.description: This dessert is SOOOO easy and delicious!!! All you need is 5 ingredients to make this! Cream cheese mixed with caramel then topped with toffee bar pieces and apples for dipping.. what is there not to love?

video.description: When the cravings come on, there’s no need to wait to get your delicious dessert fix! Simply mix together softened cream cheese with sugar and caramel sauce, then spread across a serving dish. Make it tempting with a drizzle or two more of caramel sauce and a smattering of chopped toffee bars. Chill for a half hour and when ready for awesome snacking, slice up some green apples and gather everyone around for a tasty treat!

review.reviewBody: Super easy to make, and ohh soo good. I used the pre crushed toffee bits you find by the chocolate chips, everyone thought they were nuts, I had to tell them they were toffee bits. They really didn't care because it tasted so good. I dipped the sliced apples in sprite so that they wouldn't turn brown. I will definately keep the ingrediants on hand, as this is so easy, and everyone just loved it!!

To be fair, I'm giving this 5 stars but really thought it was more of a 3 or 4 star recipe.... BUT, I used fat free cream cheese and splenda. I'm thinking full fat or even light cream cheese would have made a difference. I will keep this one around because it was nice to have a decent dip for apples..... def use regular or light cream cheese though because honestly, once you drizzle on all that caramel and top with the Heath bar, what's a few more calories :) OH, and it seemed like too much caramel on the top. Next time I will cut this down a bit and just go by looks.

Awesome dessert! The sugar is not necessary. I made it without and it was plenty sweet. Next time I will make sure I take this out 30 mins ahead of time so the cream cheese has time to soften a little bit. I'm fighting to not each the leftovers that are calling my name from the fridge!

Delicious! For those of you who have trouble with your apples turning brown, they have this stuff called Fruit Fresh. You can put a couple of tablespoons of it in a big bag and put a few tablespoons of water in there with it. Put your apple slices in there and give them a good toss. I've had apples stay good for over 2 days with this stuff. It will give it a bit more of a tart taste but not too much.

I would rate this 10 stars if I could! Don't even bother adding the sugar called for in the recipe, I didn't and it was perfect. This has to be the easiest most yummiest appetizer I have ever made. Be sure to soak the apple slices in a bowl of cold water with about a tsp. of lemon juice to keep them from turning brown. Everyone loved this. You cannot stop at one. A guaranteed hit for sure! My new favourite. Thank you Kirsten!

Very good! I've made it twice now for autumn apples here in the Midwest. The first time, per reviews, I only used two pinches of sugar. Not necessary! The second time, I used no sugar at all. It is not needed, as the dip and apples are plenty sweet. Thanks!
this is good. however I used brown sugar the second time I made it and it turned out way better. also use a little bit of lemon juice on your apples it keeps them from turning brown.
I replaced white sugar with brown sugar if you like. Can also buy the toffee bits instead of chopping candy bars for the same results.

OH. MY. GOODNESS !! Delicious, and so easy! I used Smuckers hot caramel topping (that's the name - I didn't heat the topping). I made it last night for our Christmas Party and the women in particular went crazy over it! You can go ahead and slice the apples ahead of time...just remember to either dip them in Sprite or keep the slices in cold water with lemon juice added until time to serve.

I made it without the sugar and it was plenty sweet, ate it with granny smiths - would be good with graham cracker sticks too I think. Definitely a go to recipe if you need to put something together fast!

AMAZING! Served this at a girl's night party at my house and it was a HIT! Everyone was begging for the recipe and when I told them how simple it was they couldn't believe it. Especially when you can buy the chocolate covered toffee bits to sprinkle over it (they're right next to the chocolate chips in the grocery store!) Based on other reviews I did cut the sugar by 1/2; I was a little hesitant b/c I like stuff really sweet - but it was perfect! Will definitely make again and again!
Try soaking your apples in pineapple juice while waiting to serve. Gives the apples great flavor and they won’t turn brown!!
Outstanding! I doubled the recipe and cut up green apples for the kids and my husband dipped pretzels...everyone just raved! It's a keeper! Thanks so much for this easy treat!
This is amazing and always a hit. Also goes good with pretzels and crackers.
This was okay, but nothing really special. I thought it was very, very sweet and I doubt that I'll make it again. Sorry
Excellent!!!!!
I feel awful! I was suppose to bring this to our potluck at work and I deliberately "forgot" it at home.

Easy and wonderful. Cut the sugar in half and use Fruit Fresh (found in the canning section of the grocery store), to keep the apples from browning. Everyone at my party ate this, and everyone asked for the recipe.

Loved it, loved it, loved it. I brought this to a potluck and I got so many compliments. Everyone wanted the recipe. My daughter liked it so much she asked me to make it for her to bring to her boyfriends parents for Thanksgiving. Thanks for a great recipe.
Too sweet. The women in my group really liked it. I was not impressed.
